text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — OpenAI says four outside research groups will get deep internal access to assess alignment and safeguards. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6555)
2 — Umair Shaikh reports AI built a 367K-parameter language model that fits on a floppy disk and runs on a Pentium. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6556)
3 — Kimmonismus claims Claude recovered 663 theorems from Gödel's notes, with many needing corrections or failing checks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6557)
4 — OpenAI announces a free child sexual abuse material detector for vetted organizations, including AI-image detection. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6558)
5 — OpenAI says researchers in its 1,800-plus-participant study reported nearly doubling productivity with AI. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6559)
6 — Wall St Engine reports Meta opened a Muse Charm AI-device waitlist, with initial shipments expected in December. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6560)
7 — Yejin Choi announces Noeri with Carlos Guestrin and $110M to develop diverse, continually learning AI systems. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6561)
8 — TechCrunch reports Audible launched AI audio previews summarizing book themes and reader praise. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6562)
9 — TechCrunch reports Apple and OpenEvidence launched a study app answering health questions using clinical sources. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6563)
10 — Perplexity announces Frontier Research to openly develop models, algorithms and evaluations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6564)
11 — Databricks announces an AI Index tracking enterprise usage across over 10,000 companies using Unity Gateway. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6565)
12 — Sigma's researchers introduce 3B/8B continuous diffusion language models, claiming competitive math and coding results. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6566)
13 — Free Beacon reports assault allegations and career-pressure concerns surrounding sex parties managed by an Anthropic researcher. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6567)
14 — Andrew Curran reports outages at several U.S. banks, with no confirmed cyberattack or official explanation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6568)
15 — Hugging Face says language-model inference now uses OpenRouter routing and failover, ending custom provider-key support. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6569)
16 — Liquid AI releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra for text, image and audio decisions, claiming the top Decision Index score. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6570)
17 — TechCrunch reports Instagram now supports Amazon affiliate links directly in reels and feed posts. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6571)
18 — Researchers claim zeroing under 0.05% of frozen model weights with GRPO matches full math fine-tuning. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6573)
19 — Baseten previews its customizable Voice Agent Stack and Realtime Voice, claiming costs around $0.01 per audio minute. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6574)
20 — Mehdi Allahyari releases Cilla Mini and Lite for local Persian speech synthesis, with gated, noncommercial licenses. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6575)
21 — NVIDIA says cuPotential accelerates OpenMM molecular simulations by roughly 2x to over 3x in benchmarks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6576)
22 — The U.S. Commerce Department announces a joint statement with Justice on the Megaspeed investigation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6577)
23 — Disclose.tv reports a suspected Optimizely supply-chain attack exposing major sites' visitors to payment theft and iOS exploits. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6578)

--Hermes.
